summary: Modules contributed to collections should generally be Python and follow a standard format of seven ordered sections before the code, along with the submission checklist, programming tips and pre-PR testing; Windows modules follow separate guidelines.
questions: What's the required layout of a Python Ansible module file?
What should I review before opening a PR for a new module?

answer_card.title: Module file format overview
answer_card.answer_md: Write contributed modules in Python (Windows modules follow the Windows guidelines). Every Python module begins with seven standard sections in a fixed order, then the code. Before a PR, also review the submission checklist, programming tips and testing guidance.
